task.write_section.description: Write one section of an existing document, using the document's own text.

task.write_sections_batch.description: Write several sections of an existing document.

fields.sections: list of section names to write

task.edit_section.description: Edit a section of a document as instructed.

replies.when: the task names the section by section_address: apply the edit_instruction to that section in Document Service (document_patch_section)
the task gives section_id and content: post the improved text as an edit suggestion (document_propose_edit)

task.format_section.description: Reformat a section of a document in a style.

replies.when: the content is reformatted in the given style, with no change of substance, and posted as an edit suggestion (document_propose_edit)

task.create_experiment_plan.description: Draft an experiment plan (hypothesis, methodology) for an objective; it goes to a human for approval.

fields.objective: what the experiment should find out
fields.title: plan title

task.create_experiment_plan_doc.description: Draft an experiment plan and save it as a document in a project.

fields.objective: what the experiment should find out
fields.parent_doc_id: document to attach the plan under, if any

replies.when: the plan is stored as a Document Service document of type experiment-plan (tag experiment-plan; project_id and parent_doc_id of the task) with the sections Objective, Hypothesis, Methodology

task.analyze_results.description: Analyze an experiment run's results against its plan and write the analysis into a document.

replies.when: the run and its plan are read from Experiment Service

task.analyze_experiment_doc.description: Analyze an experiment run described in a document and write the analysis into another.

replies.when: the run document and its parent plan document are read from Document Service; with an output_doc_id, the analysis is also added there as a section

query.project_state.description: Return a project's state: objectives, decisions, assignments.

query.bureau_decisions.description: List the decisions recorded for a bureau.

task.level_request.description: A request that may be the business of a project or a bureau: something to record for it (an objective, a decision, an assignment, a summary) or work for its members. Publish it with no to_agent: every project and bureau secretary sees it, the one whose project or bureau it is takes it, and its answer comes back to you.

fields.text: the request, in the person's own words

task.create_document.description: Create a new document (docx, xlsx, pdf, markdown, html, json or text) with the given sections.

fields.title: document title
fields.format: docx, xlsx, pdf, md, html, json or txt
fields.project_id: the project (its room id), if any
fields.room_id: the room to announce it in

replies.when: the document exists in Document Service (type document, with the sections asked for; for docx, xlsx and pdf its file is rendered and stored too)

event.document_changed.description: The synopses of a changed document are out of date (the maintainer gives itself this task when the Document Service events about the document have settled).

replies.when: the synopses of the document's sections and of the document are up to date

query.memory_recall.description: Searches the organization's memory for what is known about the query and returns the findings.

fields.query: what to look for, in the sender's words
fields.caller_email: whose memory it is (the person or agent asking)
fields.scope_level: 1 the agent's own, 2 its project, 3 or 4 the whole workspace (default 4)
fields.request_uid: the sender's id of this request, echoed in the reply

replies.when: the search is done, also when nothing was found (then results is an empty list and sufficient is false)

query.memory_remember.description: Keeps a piece of information in the organization's memory for the caller.

fields.content: what to remember, in full sentences
fields.caller_email: whose memory it is (the person or agent asking)
fields.request_uid: the sender's id of this request, echoed in the reply

replies.when: the information is handed to the memory (saved is true)
